yspec_profile.merge_policy: thread-local records merged once per completed frequency work item and once for main thread after joins

master_thread_work_item_root_scope_bridg.meaning: exact direct root-scope inclusive time of frequency items executed by the OpenMP master thread; included in worker scope sums and inside the outer API caller wall scope

interpretation_limits: Supervisor wall, driver elapsed, caller-thread scope totals, and summed worker scope times are distinct measurements.
Worker elapsed totals sum across frequency tasks and must not be subtracted from master or supervisor wall.
YSpec computes ParameterSet::Velocities and the adapter selects vs; DSpec contracts lnVs directly.
YSpec radial integration uses its own DepthSolves controls; the DSpec SEM mesh is only the shared sampled-output grid.
Cross-backend raw angular arrays are diagnostic only; parity is gated within each backend against its own Phase D reference.
